manifest.name: dsh-control-bar
manifest.description: 操控状态栏：模型操作你的电脑时，屏幕顶部常驻一条进度栏，并标出当前是 DeepSeek 峰时还是谷时——大额 token 的操作在峰时先问你一句，谷时直接干。
_comment: type: module —— 本包是 ESM（lib/phase.cjs 是唯一的 CommonJS 文件：宿主、覆盖层主进程、渲染端三处共用同一份峰谷算法）
main: lib/index.js —— 宿主半侧入口（Cordis 插件：name/apply）
本包没有浏览器半侧（不声明 dsh.client）：状态栏是 OS 级置顶窗，不需要页面里再画一条
dsh.bundle.patch —— 声明本包是 bundle，安装后 cordis.patch.yml 自动进层栈
dsh.compatibility.dshReleases —— 商城上架契约要求：最新三版里至少有一个 compatible
icon —— 插件管理页图标，svg，必须留在包目录内
bin —— 命令行控制（脚本/其它 Agent 也能用），见 README
peerDependencies —— 由宿主 DSH 提供的模块，本包不打包
peerDependencies 故意留空：cordis/dsh-tools 由宿主提供，本包只用普通对象与动态 import，装不上也不影响加载

bundle.text:
# ============================================================================
# dsh-control-bar 的 bundle patch —— 把操控状态栏挂进 DSH 配置树
# ============================================================================
#
# 【是什么】
#   这是本插件的"挂载声明"。DSH 启动时按 bundle 层栈把各插件的 patch 叠起来
#   组成配置树，本文件就是 dsh-control-bar 这一层。
#
# 【约定（照 dsh-pet 的实测结论）】
#   - id 必须全局唯一，且与包名一致：商城上架预检按 entryIds 比对，
#     裸名（如 control-bar）会与别的插件撞名
#   - 插件行那一行（"id: 值"）不能写行尾注释：预检用正则抓该行的值并要求
#     其后直接换行，行尾注释会让它抓不到 entry ID
#   - name 解析到包入口 lib/index.js（宿主半侧）
#   - 本插件没有浏览器半侧，因此不声明 dsh.client
#
# 【配置】
#   想改默认值就在下面加 config:（全部可选，缺省即推荐值）：
#
#   - insert:
#       - id: dsh-control-bar
#         name: 'dsh-control-bar'
#         config:
#           overlay:
#             enabled: true          # 关掉就只剩工具，不弹窗
#             height: 34             # 状态栏高度（逻辑像素）
#           pricing:
#             timezone: Asia/Shanghai
#             windows: '09:00-12:00,14:00-18:00'   # 峰时段（本地时间，含头不含尾）
#             holidays: cn-2026      # 假日预设：cn-2026 / none / 2026-01-01,2026-05-01
#           gate:
#             enabled: true
#             tokenThreshold: 200000 # 超过这个量级算"大额操作"
#
#   峰谷口径取自 DeepSeek 官方定价页：峰时为 01:00-04:00 与 06:00-10:00 UTC，
#   周一到周五，中国法定节假日与周末整日按谷时计——换算成北京时间正好是
#   09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00（周一到周五）。
# ============================================================================

- insert:
    - id: dsh-control-bar
      name: 'dsh-control-bar'

readme.text:
Whenever the agent starts driving your computer (moving the mouse, typing, running commands
that change state), a slim status bar stays pinned to the top of the screen: **正在操控**
(“controlling”) plus what it is doing right now, an honest percentage, and a badge telling you
whether DeepSeek is currently in **peak** or **off-peak** pricing hours.

Peak tokens cost twice as much as off-peak ones, so the plugin also ships a policy:
**expensive operations ask for your confirmation during peak hours, and just run off-peak.**

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

In DSH Desktop: **Plugins → Plugin Market**, search `dsh-control-bar`, install, restart.
Or from a CLI (`desktop` = your profile name):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-control-bar
```

Or straight from the repository (same thing before the npm release; there is no build step):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:JianGuo396/dsh-control-bar
```

The bar is a separate Electron process, so it needs an Electron binary. Lookup order:
`overlay.electronPath` → `DSH_CONTROL_BAR_ELECTRON` → `DSH_ELECTRON_PATH` → `$DSH_HOME/electron`
→ `~/.dsh/electron` (installing [dsh-pet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pet) puts one there).
If nothing is found the bar is skipped, everything else keeps working, and the host logs
`overlay not running (electron-not-found)`.

Nothing to do after installing, and nothing the model has to remember — the bar follows the agent's
**turn**, the same way codex's status line does:

| Host event | Bar |
|---|---|
| `turn/start` | appears with "正在工作" / "正在处理你的请求" at 4% |
| every `tool/call` | label switches to what is happening (执行命令 / 读写文件 / 查资料 / 操作浏览器…), progress advances on a monotonic curve |
| `turn/end` or `agent/error` | fills to 100% ("完成"), waits 1.2 s, then hides itself |

A turn that is interrupted, fails, or is simply forgotten can no longer leave a bar hanging on screen.
`control_bar` still works (`start`/`update`/`finish`/`hide`) when the model wants to report an exact
percentage while driving your desktop.

Manual control, also handy from scripts:

```sh
dsh-control-bar 35 "opening the browser to search"
dsh-control-bar hide
dsh-control-bar peek                       # current phase + next switch
dsh-control-bar overlay start|stop|status

| | Beijing time | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Peak | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (UTC 01:00–04:00, 06:00–10:00), excluding statutory holidays | ×2 |
| Off-peak | everything else, including weekends and holidays | ×1 |

Off-peak rates are half of peak rates per DeepSeek's pricing notes. Public holidays for 2026 are
bundled, so the check needs no network. Override `pricing.windows` / `pricing.holidays` if your
account uses a different schedule.

Gate rules written into the system prompt: during peak, a large token operation (default
threshold ≈ 200k tokens) must write `text:"峰时大额操作，等你确认"`, ask you with three options
(do it now / wait for off-peak / narrow the scope) and only continue after you pick one; off-peak
it just runs; small reads are never gated.

```yaml
- id: dsh-control-bar
  name: dsh-control-bar
  config:
    overlay:

No network calls, no telemetry. The overlay only reads a local `state.json` (a number and a
string). Its renderer is sandboxed, unfocusable, and click-through, so it never blocks the window
you are working in.
